entities.summary: Brett McLean is a Canadian former professional ice hockey centre who played in the National Hockey League for the Chicago Blackhawks, Colorado Avalanche and the Florida Panthers. McLean is currently serving as an assistant coach with the Vancouver Canucks of the National Hockey League.
